column1: Project Title: Student Attendance Management System
Project objective: Develop a web-based system that allows faculty members to record student attendance and view attendance reports.
Deliverable: Submit the working application, source code, and final project report.
Milestone: Complete database design by Week 2.
Milestone: Complete application development by Week 4.
Milestone: Finish system testing by Week 5.
The project deadline may be missed because application development is behind schedule.
We are waiting for dependency approval before integrating the authentication module.
There is not enough time to test all modules before the final submission.
Testing is blocked because the test server is unavailable.
Action item: Prepare the test cases.
